_meta.notes: V1.7 promotes 16 items (060-076) covering three concurrent fronts. (A) Raycast hotkey-overlay v0 dogfood: 060 (search-context), 062 (ask-echo Q&A with vendor-agnostic agent profiles + MCP audit sidebar), 063 (sessions-as-objects), 065 (cluster resume via singleflight), 069 (cold-start continuity hero). Documented as a single consolidated page hotkey-overlay-raycast.md; the V1-canonical hotkey-overlay.md stays planned with a v0 cross-link. (B) ECHO Pro coordinate-layer + customer install boundary: 070 (~/.echo global home), 071 (role TOML format + 3 defaults), 072 (adapter sync engine — markers in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, key-only mutation in config.toml/mcp.json, ownership classes), 073 (onboarding wizard library), 074 (echoctl CLI binary), 075 (first demo workflow change-review), 076 (packaged install boundary — daemon survives source-repo deletion via launchd plist rewrite, prepack script ships SQL migrations + skills + assets, npm-installable tarball). First customer-facing artifact in the project; design framed as the paid coordinate tier on top of the free substrate, but shipped code contains zero billing/licensing — any tarball-holder can install. (C) Substrate primitives + protocol clarification: 064 (mcp compact view projection, field-hygiene KEEP/DROP rules on find_clusters + get_atoms, principles clarification that compose-not-capture governs inputs not outputs), 066 (P1 atomic state transition primitive, process-backlog handoff atomicity), 067 (mcp request-log shutdown flush, killed_during_shutdown forensic JSONL — P2 non-graceful death still deferred). 061 doc-leanout (journal monthly shards, HTML twins gitignored, stub-and-archive backlog pattern) is operating-model hygiene only — no wiki page per its own After-Completion note. V1 form-factor surfaces still planned: hotkey-overlay (V1 canonical, distinct from v0 Raycast), audit-page.

architecture/artifact-identity.md.title: Artifact Identity (the join-key contract)
architecture/artifact-identity.md.summary: Canonical (provider, type, id) rules that decide when two artifacts refer to the same thing — powers cross-source cluster joins.

architecture/capture-allowlist.md.title: Capture Allowlist
architecture/capture-allowlist.md.summary: Five-category allowlist (apps, domains, fs_paths, apis, git_repos) declared in src/capture/sources.ts; per-source PRs add entries.

architecture/capture-gate.md.title: Capture Gate
architecture/capture-gate.md.summary: Pure-function chokepoint at src/capture/gate.ts; five source kinds, six stable rejection codes, exhaustive test coverage.

architecture/capture-pipeline.md.title: Capture Pipeline
architecture/capture-pipeline.md.summary: Thin async seam joining gate to storage; processCandidate(event, storage) gates then appends; storage is dependency-injected.

architecture/coord-active-trigger-and-ro.title: Coord active trigger + role emission (057b)
architecture/coord-active-trigger-and-ro.summary: Producer-side of the coord layer: coord_invoke MCP tool (5-step path-resolver gate + causality-safe reviewer_invoked emission + pinned-request mode with bind_failed outcome), two-phase wrapper emission via coord-emit.sh, post-push hooks in strategist skills, daemon-side internal-emitter attribution model. Activates the substrate from 057a.

architecture/coord-layer.md.title: Coord layer
architecture/coord-layer.md.summary: Generic role↔role coordination substrate over the daemon — narrow append seam + role-typed deadline tracker + identity-gated single-writer lane. Spec 057 brainstorm + decomposition rationale; ships dormant until 057a substrate + 057b active trigger activate it. Parent overview page; substrate detail in coord-substrate-and-observability, producer-side in coord-active-trigger-and-role-emission.

architecture/coord-substrate-and-observa.title: Coord substrate + observability (057a)
architecture/coord-substrate-and-observa.summary: Daemon-side coord ledger: narrow coord_emit append seam, role-typed deadline config (ajv-validated coord-roles.json), single-actor deadline tracker with cache-hit-also-terminal fireMissedDeadline, durable boot replay + periodic reconciliation, on-demand coord_status, 100k-atom V1 perf contract. Ships dormant; 057b activates emission.

architecture/group-session.md.title: Group Session
architecture/group-session.md.summary: V1.6 cross-tool coordination pattern — AI clients work the same problem through ECHO's shared substrate via wait_for_new_turns subscriptions on each others' capture sources. Implements Goal A (synchronized human-driven); Goal C (autonomous group) deferred to V2+. First-call reliability gate (item 032) closes the resume-after-gap join pattern with structural guarantees.

architecture/interface-layers.md.title: Interface Layers (1-5)
architecture/interface-layers.md.summary: Five layers of user-ECHO communication. V1 ships L1, L3, minimal L5. L2 and L4 deferred.

architecture/local-daemon.md.title: Local Daemon
architecture/local-daemon.md.summary: Local Node process owning capture, gating, SQLite storage, and MCP retrieval. Single-instance via PID lock; loopback only.

architecture/logger.md.title: Logger
architecture/logger.md.summary: Structured JSON-per-line logger; createLogger(source) bound to a subsystem; ECHO_LOG_LEVEL filters; one line per call to stdout.

architecture/mcp-compact-view-projection.title: MCP Compact View Projection
architecture/mcp-compact-view-projection.summary: Daemon-side field-hygiene projection (view: 'compact') for find_clusters + get_atoms — KEEP/DROP rules, composes with wire-shape caps, default 'rich' preserves byte-identical legacy output (item 064).

architecture/normalization.md.title: Normalization (Read-Time)
architecture/normalization.md.summary: Pure read-time layer that turns raw CaptureEvents into NormalizedContextEvent atoms via per-source adapters; storage stays raw.

architecture/normalized-context-event.md.title: NormalizedContextEvent (the atom shape)
architecture/normalized-context-event.md.summary: The joinable contract every read-path consumer speaks: schema_version 1, open vocabularies, observable hints, provenance to raw.

architecture/signal-formation.md.title: Signal Formation (Station 2)
architecture/signal-formation.md.summary: Granola signal extraction chassis: settle gate, fingerprint checkpoint, strict-JSON brain, verbatim quote anchoring, extractor_version/supersedes manifests, signal contract, skip observability.

architecture/signal-window.md.title: Signal Window (getSignalWindow)
architecture/signal-window.md.summary: Internal seam: one windowed read of raw+derived context, full fidelity; event-time and append-order (late-arrival-safe) orderings; machine/company scope; canonical_subject loop filter.

architecture/storage.md.title: Storage
architecture/storage.md.summary: Append-only Storage interface with MemoryStorage + SqliteStorage backends; WAL mode, migration runner, source_prefix + order + exclude_metadata_surface + before filters, composite (timestamp, id) ordering, canonical-Z timestamps.

architecture/system-architecture.md.title: System Architecture (Minimum Component View)
architecture/system-architecture.md.summary: Six components, three layers. Sources fan in; consumers fan out; the middle (gate + storage + MCP) is fixed. The whole system at a glance.

architecture/timestamp-canonicalization..title: Timestamp Canonicalization
architecture/timestamp-canonicalization..summary: Single-chokepoint canonicalization at capture pipeline + idempotent migration on daemon startup; every events.timestamp row is canonical UTC Z form.

architecture/work-trace.md.title: Work Trace (the trace layer)
architecture/work-trace.md.summary: Pure module that clusters normalized atoms into work threads via connected components; signal-bearing edge filter (role taxonomy), R1 open-loop resolution, span-inferred window_hours, format cap.

capture/claude-code-extractor.md.title: Claude Code Extractor
capture/claude-code-extractor.md.summary: Byte-offset tail of Claude Code session JSONL files, emitting one CaptureEvent per user/assistant turn pair.

capture/codex-extractor.md.title: Codex Extractor
capture/codex-extractor.md.summary: Byte-offset tail of OpenAI Codex CLI session JSONL files; pairs user with assistant clusters and adds cwd, config, tool, reasoning, and git metadata.

capture/cursor-extractor.md.title: Cursor Extractor
capture/cursor-extractor.md.summary: Read-only SQLite extractor turning Cursor's globalStorage composer bubbles into per-turn user/assistant CaptureEvents. Capture degraded since 2026-05-01 — Cursor migrated to agentKv: schema; rewrite gated on cohort dogfooder, not scheduled for V1.6.

capture/fs-watcher.md.title: FS Watcher
capture/fs-watcher.md.summary: First capture surface; chokidar-backed watcher emitting raw FS-event candidates under allowlisted paths, no parsing.

capture/git-capture.md.title: Git Capture
capture/git-capture.md.summary: Hybrid chokidar+poll watcher that emits one CaptureEvent per new commit (message + diff) from allowlisted git repos.

capture/per-app/claude-code-collected-da.title: Claude Code — Collected Data Reference
capture/per-app/claude-code-collected-da.summary: Field-by-field record of what ECHO reads from Claude Code's session JSONLs; user/assistant pairing, had_tool_use flag, ignored line types, empirical coverage gap on subagent JSONLs.

capture/per-app/codex-collected-data.md.title: Codex — Collected Data Reference

capture/per-app/cursor-collected-data.md.title: Cursor — Collected Data Reference
capture/per-app/cursor-collected-data.md.summary: Field-by-field record of what ECHO reads from Cursor's legacy bubbleId: / composerData: schema, where it lives, and what it becomes in CaptureEvent. Capture degraded since 2026-05-01 — agentKv: migration not yet implemented.

operating-model/adapter-freshness.md.title: Adapter freshness
operating-model/adapter-freshness.md.summary: Two-tier rendered-adapter freshness model. Repo-tracked adapters (.claude/commands/*) are gated in the merge invariant via sync-skills.sh --check; operator-local HOME-relative adapters (~/.codex/skills/ECHO:*) are checked operator-side in echoctl doctor via install-echo-codex-skills.sh --check (non-fatal degraded sub-check). Writer half (099): code-owned emit-sidecar.py + validate-sidecar.py over prose-template transcription. Decision rule: repo-tracked → merge gate; operator-local → doctor selftest. Items 099 + 100.

operating-model/automation-worktree-isol.title: Automation worktree isolation (050)
operating-model/automation-worktree-isol.summary: Each automated role (reviewer, watcher, merger) runs in its own ephemeral $TMPDIR/echo-<role>-<uuid> worktree pinned to origin/main, eliminating the shared .git/index race surface. Replaces the prior sentinel-file lock convention which depended on every binding reading it. Unified ERR/EXIT cleanup; live checkout's .git/index is never written to by an automated tick.

operating-model/builder-bindings.md.title: Builder bindings
operating-model/builder-bindings.md.summary: Three documented builder bindings — Claude Code (in-session via process-backlog skill), codex (headless via run-codex-builder.sh launchd wrapper), Cursor's Claude (IDE-mode via paste-trigger ritual). 055 closed the third-binding matrix. Add-a-binding recipe + cross-binding race semantics + operator-facing trigger differences.

operating-model/cross-tool-spec-review.m.title: Cross-Tool Spec Review
operating-model/cross-tool-spec-review.m.summary: Multi-reviewer pattern (≥2 independent AI clients per round) for specs/code/strategy. Findings classes, strategist self-review checklist, verdict-convergence signal, evidence base from items 030+032.

operating-model/merge-protocol.md.title: Merge protocol
operating-model/merge-protocol.md.summary: Founder-in-the-loop merge protocol for backlog/pending_review items. Pre-flight clean-tree check, ephemeral merger worktree (050 AC3), per-item C1-C11 loop with founder checkpoints at conflicts (C3), optional cross-vendor C3.5 consult (054), verify (C5), explicit founder live-checkout bringup at end of Step D. Thin pointer; canonical lives in skills/merge-and-cleanup.md.

operating-model/mcp-request-log-shutdown.title: MCP Request Log Shutdown Flush
operating-model/mcp-request-log-shutdown.summary: Daemon graceful-shutdown flush of in-flight MCP request rows on SIGTERM with killed_during_shutdown status to mcp-shutdown.jsonl; P2 partial closure — non-graceful death deferred (item 067).

operating-model/p1-atomic-state-transiti.title: P1 — Atomic State Transition
operating-model/p1-atomic-state-transiti.summary: Harness primitive that makes multi-step state moves crash-safe — single fsync'd index hop is the only legal observable transition. Worked example: process-backlog work-item stage move (item 066). Future consumer: merge-and-cleanup.

operating-model/review-queue-protocol.md.title: Review Queue Protocol
operating-model/review-queue-protocol.md.summary: File-backed wire protocol for strategist↔reviewer handoffs — three artifacts (request.md, <reviewer>.md, combined.md), three loop exits, fresh-eyes-at-SHA invariant

operating-model/wave-1-2-3-retrospective.title: Wave 1-2-3 Retrospective
operating-model/wave-1-2-3-retrospective.summary: Process retrospective on items 001-015: where small items, atomic claim, and drift discipline paid off — and where they didn't.

principles/ambient-form-factor.md.title: Ambient Form Factor
principles/ambient-form-factor.md.summary: Browser extension + MCP server + hotkey overlay. No destination app. Three thin presences.

principles/atomic-primitives-compose.md.title: Atomic Primitives, Compose
principles/atomic-primitives-compose.md.summary: Each MCP tool does one thing. Compound 'do everything in one call' tools are anti-patterns. The V1.6 toolkit ships 8 atomic primitives composing via 1-2 extra MCP calls. Formalized via item 038.

principles/clipboard-and-launch.md.title: Clipboard and Launch
principles/clipboard-and-launch.md.summary: Universal delivery mechanism: assemble context, copy to clipboard, open target app, user pastes.

principles/compose-not-capture.md.title: Compose, Don't Capture
principles/compose-not-capture.md.summary: ECHO ingests from tools that already capture; never builds its own capture surface for what others provide

principles/context-as-moat.md.title: Context as Moat
principles/context-as-moat.md.summary: Compete on context, not capability. Adjacent to foundation models, structurally outside their wars.

principles/drift-prevention.md.title: Drift Prevention
principles/drift-prevention.md.summary: The discipline of not silently diverging V1 build from V1 spec. Five drift patterns + weekly audit.

principles/felt-not-seen.md.title: Felt, Not Seen
principles/felt-not-seen.md.summary: Ambient by default; visible on demand for trust. Product appears in the result, not the interface.

principles/layer-above-saas.md.title: Layer Above SaaS
principles/layer-above-saas.md.summary: ECHO is additive to existing tools, never a replacement. The connective tissue between apps.

principles/sandboxed-capture.md.title: Sandboxed Capture
principles/sandboxed-capture.md.summary: Capture enforced as code via the single gate chokepoint, now exercised in production by all four V1 capture surfaces.

principles/work-artifact-first-class.md.title: Work Artifact First Class
principles/work-artifact-first-class.md.summary: Repo as a first-class retrieval predicate. Every capture surface writes metadata.repo_root; every project-scoped retrieval tool accepts repo_path; cross-project bleed is structurally impossible. Landed via item 037.

product/brand-promise.md.title: Brand Promise
product/brand-promise.md.summary: We don't make AI smarter. We make every AI smarter about you. Plus alternative formulations tested.

product/bundle-decision.md.title: Bundle Decision
product/bundle-decision.md.summary: V1 bundle: Cursor + Claude Code + GitHub + Slack + web AI extension. Why these 5; why not Zoom/email.

product/form-factor-decision.md.title: Form Factor Decision
product/form-factor-decision.md.summary: Why no destination app. Browser extension + MCP server + hotkey overlay as the three thin presences.

product/target-cohort-indie-ai-builders..summary: V1 wedge: solo devs and small-team founders shipping AI tools. Strong founder-market-fit + warm distribution.

surfaces/mcp-echo-resolve-mru.md.title: MCP echo_resolve_mru Tool
surfaces/mcp-echo-resolve-mru.md.summary: V1.6 RC2 MRU resolver — returns search_memories-ready descriptors {source, filter, phase?}; Cursor two-phase fallback (Phase 1 metadata.repo_root, Phase 2 legacy composer↔workspace registry); replaces tail_session compound modes. Item 038.

surfaces/mcp-find-clusters.md.title: MCP find_clusters Tool
surfaces/mcp-find-clusters.md.summary: V1.6 MCP discovery primitive — coherent work clusters as skeletons (atom_ids[], source_breakdown, ranks, open_loop_hints); cluster-gap controlled by window_hours; lookback by since/until. Item 032 adds no-args auto-expand (empty + single-source-recent triggers) and strict-partition demotion making prior-work clusters[0] a structural guarantee on resume-after-gap. Hard envelope ceiling 25kB; cheap.

surfaces/mcp-get-atom.md.title: MCP get_atom Tool
surfaces/mcp-get-atom.md.summary: V1.6.1 MCP verbatim escape hatch (singular — counterpart to get_atoms plural). Returns one atom with content verbatim (no match_content clip) + metadata projected via reused projectMatch (per-key cap + tool_calls reshape) + embedding excluded. Three exit shapes: success / atom_too_large_for_wire (with source populated for JSONL fallback) / atom_not_found (distinct error). Closes Magic Moment M1-3 (long-turn elision recovery) end-to-end in-MCP — no shell, no JSONL fallback, no composer-id context required. R2 truncations-correctness fix: 'content' filtered from returned truncations after verbatim override.

surfaces/mcp-get-atoms.md.title: MCP get_atoms Tool
surfaces/mcp-get-atoms.md.summary: V1.6 MCP targeted body-fetch primitive — atom bodies by ID list (≤50), wire-shape projected through projectMatch; truncations[] trust signal on every atom; deterministic prefix-drop on 25kB overflow; item 032 adds prefer='newest_first' + missing-ID-end position + duplicate-collapse asymmetry for resume calls.

surfaces/mcp-recent-work-context.md.title: MCP get_recent_work_context Tool
surfaces/mcp-recent-work-context.md.summary: DEPRECATED V1.5 MCP tool; survives in item 038 as a thin re-export shim. Cluster engine canonical home moved to src/mcp/internal/cluster-engine.ts; MCP-tool registration removal scheduled in the 2026-05-17 follow-up.

surfaces/mcp-search-memories.md.title: MCP search_memories Tool
surfaces/mcp-search-memories.md.summary: V1 MCP retrieval tool — case-insensitive substring + filters; source_app enum + post-038 source (exact) + metadata_match (whitelisted keys workspace_id/composer_id/session_id/repo_root); post-037 repo_path; composite-cursor pagination; wire-shape projection.

surfaces/mcp-server.md.title: MCP Server
surfaces/mcp-server.md.summary: Local MCP server on 127.0.0.1:38478 exposing four tools (search_memories, get_recent_work_context, tail_session, echo_ping) to MCP-compliant AI clients over stateless StreamableHTTP; outputSchema + structuredContent + readOnlyHint on every tool.

surfaces/mcp-wait-for-new-turns.md.title: MCP wait_for_new_turns Tool
surfaces/mcp-wait-for-new-turns.md.summary: V1.6 MCP group-session subscription primitive — stateless long-poll on watched sources; post-038 IDs-only contract (returns turn_ids: string[], callers compose get_atoms/get_atom); post-037 repo_path; max 60s timeout; implements Goal A of group-session.
